headline: Backend Engineer | Java and Microservices
summary: Highly motivated backend engineer with 3+ years of experience designing, developing, and deploying robust and scalable applications. Proven ability to work independently and collaboratively in fast-paced environments. Passionate about learning new technologies and implementing best practices.

bullets: Developed and maintained core backend services using Java Spring Boot, resulting in a 15% reduction in application latency.
Implemented a new messaging queue system using Kafka to improve asynchronous communication between microservices, leading to a 20% increase in throughput.
Migrated existing database schema to PostgreSQL, improving data query performance by 10%.
Collaborated with frontend developers to integrate new features and functionalities, ensuring seamless user experience.
Developed REST APIs using Java and Spring Boot to integrate with various third-party services.
Contributed to the development of a new customer management system, which resulted in a 5% increase in customer satisfaction.
Assisted senior developers in debugging and resolving complex technical issues.
Participated in code reviews and provided constructive feedback to improve code quality.
